'''TriGas Corporation''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company that owned the rights to mine the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Nosken]]. Many years before [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]]<ref>''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> they conducted a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] mining operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] using [[dirigible]]s, which ultimately proved to be a failure.<ref name="GG2" />
